zh.title: ACI EUROPE、IATA 等成立生物辨識旅運聯盟　向歐盟提出自願使用原則
zh.summary: 五個航空與科技組織成立 Responsible Biometrics Travel Industry Coalition，主張歐盟法規應允許旅客自願使用生物辨識並保留非生物辨識替代方案。
body: ACI EUROPE、Amadeus、國際航空運輸協會（IATA）、IDEMIA 與 SITA 於 2026 年 10 月 1 日宣布成立 Responsible Biometrics Travel Industry Coalition。聯盟希望歐盟在 Digital Omnibus 法規工作中建立可實施的生物辨識旅運框架。
聯盟提出的原則包括旅客自願選擇、提供非生物辨識替代流程、資料最小化與刪除，以及技術中立。其主張是讓旅客可在機場多個流程使用同一數位身分，同時保留隱私與選擇權。
這份宣言是產業團體的政策倡議，並非已通過的歐盟法規。後續仍須由歐盟機構在立法與監管程序中決定是否採納。

en.title: ACI EUROPE, IATA and partners form biometric-travel coalition with voluntary-use principles
en.summary: Five aviation and technology organizations want EU rules to enable voluntary biometric journeys while preserving a non-biometric alternative and privacy safeguards.
body: ACI EUROPE, Amadeus, the International Air Transport Association, IDEMIA and SITA announced the Responsible Biometrics Travel Industry Coalition on October 1, 2026. The group is asking the European Union to provide a workable biometric-travel framework through its Digital Omnibus work.

Its principles include voluntary participation, a non-biometric alternative, data minimization and deletion, and technology neutrality. The coalition argues that passengers should be able to use a digital identity across multiple airport processes while retaining privacy and choice.
The manifesto is an industry policy proposal, not enacted EU law. Any implementation remains subject to EU legislative and regulatory decisions.

facts.claim: ACI EUROPE, Amadeus, IATA, IDEMIA and SITA announced the Responsible Biometrics Travel Industry Coalition on 2026-10-01.
The coalition calls for voluntary participation, a non-biometric alternative, data minimization and deletion, and technology-neutral rules.
The coalition is asking the EU to address biometric travel in the Digital Omnibus; its manifesto is a proposal rather than enacted law.
